card.name: Environmental policy press statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation inside environmental advocacy or policy press releases, such as clean energy, climate legislation and clean water statements. It fires on words like to, towards, for, a and a period within these quotes.

modes.label: Linking words in climate quotes
modes.description: Prepositions and articles in advocacy quotes about shifting to clean energy or away from fossil fuels.
modes.example: approach to regulating global warming pollution which is necessary to achieve the critically needed shift<< to>> a clean energy economy.
